finding.claim: Empty or non-JSON stdin makes the verb quiet instead of falling back to --path, so `kmctl summary nudge --path DIR` run by an agent's Bash tool, a script or CI (stdin not a terminal, usually empty) prints nothing even when the summary is behind. The epilog's own example `kmctl summary nudge --path ../other-repo` therefore does nothing outside a terminal. briefing's hook_workspace, the sibling surface, falls back to --path on empty or bad stdin.

fixes.change: an explicit --path is the fallback when stdin has no usable cwd; new --json prints behind, concepts and nudge, refused with --format claude; help and epilog say so
explicit --path with each unusable stdin nudges; empty stdin without --path stays quiet; --json shapes, repeat, failure and the refused pair
